page.layout: One running head across the top, with the page number at the left. Below it one column of short name lines, grouped under years, and the column runs from top to bottom. No notes in the margins.; Running head at the top, cut off at the left edge; below it a long vertical printed rule down the page; no text block visible in this part.; One narrow column of lines, set as a list: years, names and magistrate titles, centred or ranged left, running from the top of the scan to a partial last line. No margins, running head or page number.
page.notes: The running head is cut at the right edge; only "Catalogus Hor" is legible, so the final letters are marked [?]. "Hornekens" (1565) and "Sasscher" are read as printed; the long s is written as s. The years are printed as Arabic numerals, copied as they stand. Faint dots and marks at the foot are not printed text and are left out. A long vertical printed rule runs down the page, with no text beside it. Scattered specks and marks are not printed text. The left edge of the first line is cut off, so the opening word is a fragment. The last line is partly visible; only "Reint" can be read. "Thedemg" in the 1572 entry is printed with a damaged final letter; I read it as Thedema and marked it [?]. Long s has been written as plain s.
